measurement_protocol.warmup_rationale: the exact five-prompt workload is measured without adding an unregistered prompt; init is separately timed and excluded from per-prompt TTFT
measurement_protocol.greedy_reason: top_k=1 makes top_p and temperature non-operative
measurement_protocol.board_clock_policy: controller before/after is absolute authority; board wall time is recorded, monotonic-raw is duration/alignment authority

callback.transcript_storage: one raw UTF-8 file per carrier and prompt

telemetry.fields: CPU/NPU/DMC frequency and governor, all thermal zones, NPU load

process_perf_stat.scope: each carrier process including RKLLM worker threads

metric_definitions.wall_ttft_ms: (first NORMAL callback monotonic_raw_ns - rkllm_run call start monotonic_raw_ns) / 1e6
metric_definitions.callback_token_interval_ms: difference between consecutive NORMAL callback timestamps within one prompt; WAITING callbacks are recorded but excluded
metric_definitions.primary_aggregate_decode_ms_per_token: sum(last NORMAL - first NORMAL) across valid prompts / sum(NORMAL callback count - 1), in milliseconds
metric_definitions.rkllm_perf_decode_ms_per_token: sum(RKLLMPerfStat.generate_time_ms) / sum(RKLLMPerfStat.generate_tokens), reported as a runtime cross-check when token counts are positive
metric_definitions.stage_breakdown: RKLLMPerfStat prefill/generate fields plus wall callback timings; residual is descriptive and is not forced into an undocumented SDK stage
metric_definitions.npu_load_curve: 10-Hz core0/core1/core2 samples aligned to each prompt run window on CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW
metric_definitions.cpu_participation: perf task-clock divided by carrier runner wall span, plus cycles/instructions/IPC

anchor.core_projection_label: 258 core projection calls; not all non-lmhead linear
anchor.gap_formula_pct: (measured aggregate decode ms/token - predicted lower bound ms) / predicted lower bound ms * 100
anchor.interpretation_limit: the prediction assumes full listed weight traffic at the CPU triad ceiling and is only a lower-bound accounting anchor; SRAM reuse, weight compression, and scheduling bubbles remain candidates unless directly supported

frozen_prohibitions: driver, kernel, device-tree, runtime .so, or frozen model modification
